import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    private static int readSum(int left, Scanner sc) {
        if (left <= 0) return 0;
        int value = sc.nextInt();
        return value + readSum(left - 1, sc);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int total = readSum(n, sc);
        System.out.println(total / n);
        sc.close();
    }
}
